metadata.title: Géométrographie & Dual Minimal-Instrument Constructibility Concordance
treatises: Émile Lemoine, Géométrographie, ou Art des constructions géométriques (1892 / 1902)
Lorenzo Mascheroni, La Geometria del Compasso (1797)
Jakob Steiner, Die geometrischen Constructionen, ausgeführt mittelst der geraden Linie und Eines festen Kreises (1833)

entries.title_en: Straight Line Joining Two Given Points
entries.title_fr: Tracer la droite joignant deux points donnés A et B

mascheroni.method: A straight line cannot be continuously traced without a straightedge; Mascheroni represents line AB implicitly by its point-pair (A, B) and constructs collinear multiples (§ 64) or intersections (§ 112) by compass arcs alone.

steiner.locus: Einleitung § 1; Drittes Kapitel § 18, II ([68], p. 50)
steiner.method: Primitive straightedge operation (2R_1 + R_2): joining two given points with the ruler is immediately permitted without consulting the fixed circle M.

entries.notes: Establishes the fundamental ruler cost 2R_1 + R_2 (S = 3, E = 2) against which all straightedge alignments are measured.

entries.title_en: Laying Off a Given Segment Along a Traced Line
entries.title_fr: Porter sur une droite tracée une longueur donnée AB

mascheroni.method: Modern divider-compass transfer (3C_1 + C_3 from a given origin M, or 5-circle reflection/parallelogram when transferring onto an un-drawn line defined by two points).

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Sechste Aufgabe ([76]–[78], pp. 56–57)
steiner.method: Pure straightedge transfer of segment M_1 a_1 to a given origin M_2 by constructing the centers of similitude A_1, I_1 of the fixed circle M and the virtual circle (M_2, M_1 a_1).

entries.notes: Euclid I.2–I.3 avoids assuming a divider compass that retains its opening when lifted (S = 16); Lemoine's modern compass takes AB in 2C_1 and lays it off in C_2 + C_3 (or C_1 + C_3 from a fixed point, S = 4, E = 3).

entries.title_en: Constructing at a Given Point an Angle Equal to a Given Angle
entries.title_fr: Construire en un point donné d'une droite un angle égal à un angle donné

mascheroni.method: Given angle ABC by three points and target ray ba, constructs fourth proportionals (§ 93) or equal-radius chord transfer (5C_1 + 3C_3 when radii AB = ab are chosen equal) to locate c.

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Vierte Aufgabe ([75], p. 55, Fig. 21)
steiner.method: Draws diameters ab, cd of the fixed circle M parallel to the sides of angle AmC and ef parallel to EF, transfers the central angle via parallel chords ce and ag, and draws pq parallel to diameter gMh.

entries.notes: Euclid's reduction of I.23 to I.22 joins a speculative auxiliary chord across the given angle; equal-radius arc transfer cuts S from 19 to 11.

entries.title_en: Triangle from Three Given Sides
entries.title_fr: Construire un triangle connaissant les trois côtés a, b, c

mascheroni.method: Once base endpoints B, C are separated by a, two compass arcs of radii b and c (6C_1 + 2C_3) determine the third vertex A directly without tracing the three side lines.

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Sechste & Achte Aufgabe ([76]–[85], pp. 56–62)
steiner.method: Transfers lengths a, b, c via Sixth Problem and intersects the two virtual circles (B, c) and (C, b) via their radical axis (Eighth Problem) using straightedge alone.

entries.notes: Drawing the initial carrier line as an arbitrary line R_2 (rather than joining two pre-placed points) saves 2R_1 + C_1 over textbook execution.

entries.title_en: Parallel Through an External Point to a Given Line
entries.title_fr: Par un point donné A hors d'une droite BC, mener une parallèle à BC

mascheroni.method: Opposite-side parallelogram: with A, B on the given line and external point C, draw B(CA) and C(BA) meeting at D (5C_1 + 2C_3, S = 7, E = 5 for point D alone!).

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Erste Aufgabe ([68]–[71], pp. 50–52, Fig. 19)
steiner.method: Pure straightedge parallel via a diameter aMb of the fixed circle (providing midpoint M of ab) and complete-quadrangle harmonic construction (11R_1 + 6R_2 when line passes through M).

entries.notes: Gaston Tarry discovered two S = 9 constructions: 1° two equal-radius circles passing through A (2R_1 + R_2 + 4C_1 + 2C_3, E = 6, 2 circles), and 2° single-aperture rhombus (2R_1 + R_2 + 3C_1 + 3C_3, E = 5, 3 circles).

entries.title_en: Perpendicular Bisector and Midpoint of a Segment
entries.title_fr: Tracer la perpendiculaire au milieu de AB, ou trouver le milieu de AB
entries.pappus_ref: Harmonic conjugate of point at infinity

mascheroni.locus: Libro III, § 66 Sol. I–V (pp. 32–33, Figs. 14–17); Libro IV, § 79 (p. 43)
mascheroni.method: Bisecting AB without a drawn line takes 7 circles in Sol. V (10C_1 + 7C_3, S = 17): double AB to E via 4 unit-radius arcs, draw E(EB) cutting B(BA) at P, p, then P(PB) and p(PB) meet at midpoint M.

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Zweite & Dritte Aufgabe ([71]–[75], pp. 52–55)
steiner.method: Draws a line parallel to AB (First Problem) to bisect AB harmonically via a complete quadrangle (Second Problem, b), then erects the perpendicular via Third Problem.

entries.notes: Keeping an arbitrary compass opening > AB/2 avoids setting the compass on B to measure AB, saving 1 C_1 (S = 7 vs. Euclid's equilateral-triangle S = 8).

entries.title_en: Symmetric Reflection of a Point Across a Traced Line
entries.title_fr: Construire le symétrique A' d'un point A par rapport à une droite tracée BC

mascheroni.method: Identical two-circle compass-only reflection! When B and C are given points on the mirror line, B(BA) and C(CA) intersect at A' in 4C_1 + 2C_3 (or 3C_1 + 3C_3 if radii share opening), S = 6.

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Dritte & Sechste Aufgabe ([71]–[78], pp. 52–57)
steiner.method: Drops the perpendicular from A to BC meeting BC at foot M (Third Problem), then doubles AM harmonically to A' via a parallel line (Second Problem).

entries.notes: Crucial géométrographique primitive: Lemoine uses compass-only reflection (0 lines, 2 circles, S = 6) inside his symmedian X(6) and tangent constructions.

entries.title_en: Perpendicular to a Traced Line from an External Point
entries.title_fr: Mener par un point extérieur A la perpendiculaire à une droite tracée BC

mascheroni.method: Reflects D across AB to E in 2 arcs B(BD), A(AD) (determining the perpendicular line DE in S = 6!), and if foot M is required, bisects DE by § 66.

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Dritte Aufgabe A & B ([71]–[75], pp. 52–55, Fig. 20)
steiner.method: When BC is a diameter ab of the fixed circle, joins Pa, Pb meeting the circle at c, d; lines ad and bc meet at orthocenter p_1, and Pp_1 is perpendicular to ab (10R_1 + 5R_2, S = 15!).

entries.notes: Instead of drawing a circle centered at A cutting BC twice and then bisecting the chord (3 circles, S = 10), Lemoine reflects A across two centres on BC (2 circles, S = 9).

entries.title_en: Perpendicular Erected at a Given Point on a Traced Line
entries.title_fr: Élever en un point donné A d'une droite BC la perpendiculaire à BC

mascheroni.method: 3-circle Thales semicircle (§ 77): with arbitrary radius r, draw A(r) and B(r) meeting at C, then trace semicircle C(r) stepping two chords from B to D; AD is perpendicular to AB (3C_1 + 5C_3 or 4C_1 + 3C_3 + stepping).

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Dritte Aufgabe A ([71]–[72], pp. 52–53)
steiner.method: Constructs orthogonal chords in the fixed circle via diameters (Euclid III.31) and draws the parallel through A on BC.

entries.notes: Thales single-circle construction: place compass at an arbitrary point O off BC, draw O(OA) (C_1 + C_3) cutting BC again at B, draw diameter BO cutting O(OA) at D (2R_1 + R_2), and join AD (2R_1 + R_2) — only 1 circle and S = 8!

entries.title_en: Bisecting a Given Rectilinear Angle
entries.title_fr: Diviser un angle donné BAC en deux parties égales

mascheroni.method: Bisects the subtended arc BD of circle A(AB) via Mascheroni's arc-bisection parallelogram (§ 60) using compass arcs alone.

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Fünfte Aufgabe, Fall a ([75]–[76], pp. 55–56, Fig. 21)
steiner.method: Draws diameters ab, cd of fixed circle M parallel to sides mA, mC so central angle aMc = AmC; the line through vertex m parallel to chord ad (or cb) bisects angle AmC!

entries.notes: Retaining the same sufficient radius R for the initial arc at A and the two intersecting arcs from B and D avoids resetting the compass, reducing S from 10 to 9.

entries.title_en: Circumcircle and Circumcenter X(3) Through Three Given Points
entries.title_fr: Circonscrire un cercle à un triangle donné ABC, ou faire passer un cercle par A, B, C

mascheroni.method: Paired with Napoleon's Problem (§ 143, center of a drawn circle in 6 arcs): § 144 finds circumcenter O of three non-collinear points M, A, B by compass inversion/third-proportional arcs alone.

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Zweite & Dritte Aufgabe ([71]–[75], pp. 52–55)
steiner.method: Constructs the perpendicular bisectors of AB and AC by straightedge via fixed circle M; their intersection is X(3) (while the circle itself remains represented by center O and radius OA).

entries.notes: Sharing circle B(R) across both perpendicular bisectors AB and BC cuts the circle count from 5 to 4 (3 mediatrix circles + circumcircle O(OA), S = 15).

entries.title_en: Tangents to a Given Circle from an External Point
entries.title_fr: Mener d'un point extérieur A les tangentes à un cercle donné O

mascheroni.method: Finds midpoint M of OA (§ 66) or uses concentric radius 2R arc and circle A(OA) to determine contact points T, T' on O(R) by compass alone.

steiner.locus: Erstes Kapitel, § 10 ([26]–[30], pp. 20–23)
steiner.method: Pure straightedge construction! Draw two arbitrary secants from A cutting the drawn circle O, construct the polar of A via the complete inscribed quadrangle (Lemoine XXXIX, 12R_1 + 7R_2), and join A to its two intersections T, T' with circle O.

entries.notes: Highlights instrument duality: when circle O is already drawn, Steiner's projective polar method needs ZERO circles (16R_1 + 9R_2 for both tangents), whereas Lemoine optimizes the metric ruler-and-compass construction to S = 18.

entries.title_en: Incircle and Incenter X(1) of a Given Triangle
entries.title_fr: Inscrire un cercle dans un triangle donné ABC

mascheroni.method: Determines incenter X(1) and inradius by compass-only angle bisections (§ 118) and line intersection (§ 112) + reflection (§ 78).

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Dritte & Fünfte Aufgabe ([71]–[76], pp. 52–56)
steiner.method: Bisects angles B and C via parallel diameters of fixed circle M (Fifth Problem) to meet at incenter I = X(1), then drops perpendicular from I to BC (Third Problem) to obtain touchpoint D.

entries.notes: One of Lemoine's signature triumphs: eliminates 4 circles and 1 line (S: 30 -> 23) by reusing a single compass radius across vertices and measuring the perpendicular distance from I to BC without tracing the altitude line!

entries.title_en: Fourth Proportional to Three Given Segments
entries.title_fr: Construire la quatrième proportionnelle x = bc/a à trois longueurs a, b, c

mascheroni.method: Remarkably compact concentric-circle construction! Draw concentric circles O(a) and O(b); place chord BC = c in O(a), then step equal arcs BD = CE on O(b) from B and C to read chord DE = bc/a directly in 4 circles!

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Erste & Sechste Aufgabe ([68]–[78], pp. 50–57)
steiner.method: Transfers segments onto two intersecting rays from O (Sixth Problem) and draws the Thales parallel via fixed circle M (First Problem).

entries.notes: Fazzari's 1901 Palermo preface (p. xi) singles out Mascheroni's concentric-circle fourth proportional (§ 93, S = 14 when a <= 2c!) as simpler even than standard ruler-and-compass Thales constructions.

entries.title_en: Mean Proportional (Geometric Mean) of Two Segments
entries.title_fr: Construire la moyenne proportionnelle entre deux longueurs données a et b

mascheroni.method: Extracts sqrt(ab) by compass arcs alone using power-of-a-point / semicircle chord relations without drawing the diameter line.

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Dritte & Siebente Aufgabe ([71]–[82], pp. 52–60)
steiner.method: Intersects the altitude at the junction of a and b with the virtual semicircle on diameter a + b via Seventh Problem (line-circle intersection with fixed circle M).

entries.notes: The Lemoine–Gouzy construction cuts S by 42% (24 -> 14), halving the circle count from 6 to 3.

entries.title_en: Division in Extreme and Mean Ratio (Golden Section phi)
entries.title_fr: Diviser une droite donnée AB en moyenne et extrême raison

mascheroni.method: Mascheroni's 5-circle regular decagon/pentagon division: stepping three hexagon chords B, C, D of radius r = AB around O(r) gives AC = BD = r*sqrt(3); intersecting A(AC) and D(BD) at E gives OE = r*sqrt(2), whence the decagon chord AB/phi and extreme-and-mean section (§ 128) follow by compass alone.

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Dritte, Sechste & Siebente Aufgabe ([71]–[82], pp. 52–60)
steiner.method: Erects perpendicular BC = AB/2 at B by straightedge (Second & Third Problems) and intersects line AC with virtual circle C(CB) via Seventh Problem, then transfers segment to AB via Sixth Problem.

entries.notes: Lemoine traces ONLY ONE straight line (the perpendicular at B obtained simultaneously with the midpoint arc) instead of three lines in classical II.11/VI.30, cutting S from 25 to 18.

entries.title_en: Inverse of a Given Point with Respect to a Given Circle
entries.title_fr: Construire l'inverse A' d'un point A par rapport à un cercle O(R)

mascheroni.locus: Libro V, § 86 (p. 46, Fig. 35); August Adler (1890) inversion proof of Mohr–Mascheroni
mascheroni.method: Identical 3-circle compass-only inversion (when OA > R/2): draw A(AO) cutting O(R) at M, N; then M(MO) and N(NO) intersect at A' with OA * OA' = R^2! (When OA <= R/2, double OA k times first.)

steiner.locus: Erstes Kapitel, § 10 ([26]–[30], pp. 20–23)
steiner.method: Pure straightedge inversion! Construct the polar p of A with respect to the fixed circle O via an inscribed quadrangle, join OA, and intersect OA with p at A'.

entries.notes: August Adler (1890) proved the entire Mohr–Mascheroni theorem at a stroke by observing that Lemoine's 5C_1 + 3C_3 inversion maps lines and circles into circles and lines using the compass alone.

entries.title_en: Polar Line of a Given Point with Respect to a Traced Circle
entries.title_fr: Construire la polaire d'un point donné A par rapport à un cercle tracé O

mascheroni.method: Constructs the inverse A' of A in circle O (5C_1 + 3C_3) and a second point on the perpendicular to OA at A' (§ 77).

steiner.locus: Erstes Kapitel, § 10, III–IV ([27]–[29], pp. 21–22)
steiner.method: Exact same pure-straightedge inscribed quadrangle construction (12R_1 + 7R_2, S = 19, 0 circles), which works whether A lies outside or inside the circle and without needing the center O!

entries.notes: Demonstrates that even inside standard ruler-and-compass Géométrographie, pure projective straightedge synthesis beats metric compass-and-ruler constructions (S = 19 vs. S = 25).

entries.title_en: Radical Axis of Two Non-Intersecting Traced Circles
entries.title_fr: Construire l'axe radical de deux cercles tracés non sécants

mascheroni.method: Divides line of centers OO' at M where OM^2 - O'M^2 = R^2 - R'^2 via compass-only fourth proportional and erects a perpendicular point (§ 77).

steiner.locus: Zweites Kapitel, §§ 15–17 ([61]–[67], pp. 45–50); Achte Aufgabe ([82]–[85], pp. 60–62)
steiner.method: Steiner coins the term 'Linie der gleichen Potenzen' and constructs the radical axis of two arbitrary circles by straightedge alone via their centers of similitude with the fixed circle M!

entries.notes: In his famous reply to Amédée Mannheim (pp. 57–58), Lemoine contrasts Mannheim's midpoint-of-common-tangents construction (S = 58!) against two arbitrary secant circles C_3 + C_3 yielding radical center and axis in S = 17.

entries.title_en: Harmonic Conjugate of a Point with Respect to a Segment
entries.title_fr: Construire le conjugué harmonique D d'un point C par rapport à A et B
entries.pappus_ref: Pappus Book VII Prop. 131 complete quadrilateral

mascheroni.method: Computes BD from AD : BD = AC : BC via proportional segment division (§ 96) with compass arcs alone.

steiner.method: Identical pure-straightedge complete quadrilateral construction (9R_1 + 6R_2, S = 15, 0 circles) — didn't even require the fixed circle M!

entries.notes: Projective invariant cross-ratio (A, B; C, D) = -1 constructed with zero compass operations; choosing the first auxiliary ray as R_1 + R_2 through A saves 3R_1 over naive alignment.

entries.title_en: Centroid G = X(2) of a Given Triangle
entries.title_fr: Construire le centre de gravité G d'un triangle donné ABC

mascheroni.method: Finds midpoint M_a of BC (§ 66) and trisects median AM_a at G via compass-only trisection (§ 68).

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Erste & Zweite Aufgabe ([68]–[71], pp. 50–52)
steiner.method: Draws parallels to two sides via fixed circle M to bisect them harmonically, then intersects two medians by straightedge.

entries.notes: Lemoine forms parallelogram ABDC with only 2 circles B(AC) and C(AB) so AD bisects BC without drawing BC's perpendicular bisector, cutting S from 18 to 17 (2 circles instead of 3).

entries.title_en: Lemoine Symmedian Point K = X(6) of a Given Triangle
entries.title_fr: Construire le point de Lemoine K d'un triangle donné ABC
entries.pappus_ref: Harmonic pole of Lemoine line / Gergonne-symmedian duality

mascheroni.method: Lemoine's antiparallel-reflection construction is already nearly compass-pure (8 circles, only 2 symmedian lines)! Intersecting those two symmedian point-pairs via Mascheroni § 112 yields X(6) by compass alone.

steiner.locus: Erstes Kapitel, § 10; Drittes Kapitel, § 18 ([26]–[30], [68]–[75])
steiner.method: Once circumcircle (ABC) is drawn, X(6) is constructed by PURE STRAIGHTEDGE without a single compass operation: construct the tangents at A, B, C via polars and join each vertex to the pole of its opposite side!

entries.notes: Lemoine discovered X(6) in 1873 (AFAS Lyon, 'Sur quelques propriétés d'un point remarquable du triangle'). In Problem LI he halves the trilinear-coordinate cost (S: 54 -> 27) by reflecting antiparallel midpoints using only 2 traced lines!

entries.title_en: First and Second Brocard Points omega and omega' of a Triangle
entries.title_fr: Construire les points de Brocard ω et ω' d'un triangle donné ABC
entries.pappus_ref: Harmonic/isogonal Brocard circle on diameter OK

mascheroni.method: Constructs the centers of the adjoint tangent circles by compass-only perpendiculars and circumcenter arcs, locating ω and ω' as second intersections of the adjoint circles.

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Erste, Dritte & Achte Aufgabe ([68]–[85], pp. 50–62)
steiner.method: Constructs parallels and perpendiculars at A, B, C via fixed circle M to locate the adjoint circle centers, then intersects the virtual adjoint circles via their radical axes (Eighth Problem).

entries.notes: In his reply to Henri Brocard (pp. 58–59), Lemoine dissects Brocard's own classical three-adjoint-circle trace (S = 74) and cuts the simultaneous cost nearly in half (S = 38; single Brocard point LIV takes 8R_1 + 4R_2 + 10C_1 + 6C_3, S = 28).

entries.title_en: Nagel Point X(8) of a Given Triangle
entries.title_fr: Construire le point de Nagel X(8) d'un triangle donné ABC

mascheroni.method: Transfers side lengths along the extended sides by three compass arcs to mark two excircle touchpoints T_b, T_c, then intersects cevians AT_b and BT_c by § 112.

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Sechste Aufgabe ([76]–[78], pp. 56–57)
steiner.method: Transfers side lengths along the triangle's sides via centers of similitude with fixed circle M to locate T_b, T_c, then joins AT_b and BT_c by straightedge.

entries.notes: Instead of constructing two excircles via exterior angle bisectors (S = 34), Lemoine lays off semiperimeter differences directly with 3 circles and joins two Nagel cevians in S = 16!

entries.title_en: Mascheroni Compass-Only Midpoint & Intersection of Two Lines
entries.title_fr: Géométrographie Mascheronienne : milieu de AB et intersection de deux droites au compas seul

mascheroni.locus: Libro III, § 66 Sol. V (p. 33, Fig. 14); Libro VII, §§ 110–112 (pp. 60–63, Figs. 46–50)
mascheroni.method: Proves compass-only completeness: line-circle intersection (§§ 110–111) and line-line intersection (§ 112, via symmetric points c, d across AB, parallelogram CDd-delta, and fourth proportional c-delta : CD = Cc : CS) reduce all Euclidean constructions to C_1, C_2, C_3.

steiner.locus: Einleitung § 2 ([2]–[4], pp. 4–5)
steiner.method: Steiner opens his 1833 treatise by contrasting Mascheroni's exclusion of the straightedge with the dual projective program of excluding the compass altogether.

entries.notes: In Géométrographie Mascheronienne (r1 = r2 = 0), bisecting an un-drawn segment AB takes 10C_1 + 7C_3 (S = 17, 7 circles), whereas reflecting a point takes 4C_1 + 2C_3 (S = 6) and constructing a parallel point takes 5C_1 + 2C_3 (S = 7).

entries.title_en: Poncelet–Steiner Straightedge-Only Parallel & Virtual Circle Intersections
entries.title_fr: Géométrographie Steinerienne : parallèle et intersections de cercles à la règle seule avec un cercle fixe
entries.pappus_ref: Poncelet–Steiner Theorem (complete quadrangle + centers of similitude + radical axis)

mascheroni.method: Dual counterpart: where Mascheroni simulates straight lines via pairs of points and fourth-proportional arcs, Steiner simulates un-drawn circles via centers of similitude and radical axes.

steiner.locus: Drittes Kapitel, § 18, Erste bis Achte Aufgabe ([68]–[85], pp. 50–62, Figs. 19–24)
steiner.method: Proves straightedge-only completeness given ONE fixed circle with center M: parallel to a diameter aMb takes 11R_1 + 6R_2 (S = 17, 6 lines, 0 circles); Seventh & Eighth Problems find line-circle and circle-circle intersections of un-drawn circles via Aehnlichkeitspunkte A, I and the radical axis.

entries.notes: Notice that center M IS indispensable: by Poncelet–Steiner–Hilbert projective invariance, a projective transformation fixing a circle without fixing its center destroys Euclidean parallelism and orthogonality!
